coverage_boundary: Coverage is complete only for this frozen finite Cartesian projection. It is not coverage of all ECDLP ideas or literature.

temperature_legend.cold: A typed cell rejected by at least one deterministic structural gate.
temperature_legend.warm: A structurally coherent research-question cell that still lacks an assured exact mechanism and independent source review.
temperature_legend.hot: A cell with an assured mechanism, cost bridge, and independent review. This generator cannot create hot cells.

feedback_context.binding_rule: Every listed evidence change invalidates the instance root. Digest-bound reviews are summarized by base ID, but no label automatically clears a hard gate or creates hot state.
